choices.outcome: The shuttle lifts off, leading to a chase.
You enter the void, facing survival challenges.
You spot drones, leading to a tactical retreat.

scenes.title: Malgrim Confrontation
scenes.background: A grand chamber in Vanlander Prison, where Lord Malgrim stands before a throne of Grackle tech. His armor glows with alien energy, and guards flank him.
scenes.music: A dark, orchestral track with a synthetic undertone, building to a climax.
scenes.description: Malgrim arrives, his presence dominating the chamber as he stands before a throne of Grackle tech, his armor glowing with alien energy. Guards flank him, their weapons trained on you, and he sneers, “Your resistance ends here. Join me, or face oblivion.” The room pulses with power, and a strange device on his throne hums, hinting at a deeper connection. What do you do?

choices.outcome: Malgrim overpowers you, leading to capture and the final twist.
Malgrim mocks you, leading to capture and the twist.
The device malfunctions, weakening Malgrim, but he captures you.

scenes.title: New Plan
scenes.background: Your cell in Vanlander Prison, where the guards have relaxed. A faint hum from the walls suggests a power source nearby.
scenes.music: A subtle track with a low hum and distant clanks.
scenes.description: The guards relax, believing you subdued, and a faint hum from the walls hints at a power source. The rebel is gone, but a loose vent offers a chance to escape again. The hum grows louder, suggesting a weakness. What do you do?

choices.outcome: You reach a maintenance shaft, leading to escape.
You find a power core, offering sabotage.
The guards depart, leading to a new escape.

scenes.title: Cave Shelter
scenes.background: A dark cave on the asteroid, where the rebel lies injured. The nebula glows outside, and Grackle drones patrol the entrance.
scenes.music: A quiet track with soft hums and distant engine sounds.
scenes.description: You drag the rebel into the cave, the nebula’s glow filtering through the entrance. The rebel is injured, groaning softly, and Grackle drones patrol outside, their beams sweeping the asteroid. A faint crystal in the cave pulses, possibly useful. What do you do?

choices.outcome: The rebel recovers, aiding your next move.
The crystal emits a signal, drawing faeries or Grackles.
The drones depart, allowing escape.

scenes.title: Final Showdown
scenes.background: Malgrim’s fortress throne room, a fusion of Eldorian stone and Grackle tech. Malgrim looms over you, his power overwhelming, as the device on his throne crackles.
scenes.music: A dramatic orchestral track with a rising synthetic crescendo, building to a climax.
scenes.description: You face Lord Malgrim in his fortress throne room, a fusion of Eldorian stone and Grackle tech. His power overwhelms you, his armor pulsing as he strikes, knocking you to your knees. The device on his throne crackles, and all hope seems lost as he declares, “Your journey ends here!” Guards close in, and the room darkens—until the device emits a blinding light, its surface shimmering with unfamiliar runes. The world begins to melt, the fortress dissolving into a surreal haze, revealing a tavern interior. Arnie’s voice cuts through, “Whoa, folks, that’s a wrap!” Chunt the talking badger laughs, “Nice twist, huh?” Usidore the wizard waves his staff, “A conjuration well-told!” You realize this was a story, recorded at the WanderLost tavern for their podcast, Hello from the Magic Tavern. The characters grin, inviting you to join the next episode. The end.

choices.text: The story concludes, leaving you with the characters in the tavern.
choices.outcome: The narrative ends, transitioning to a meta-conclusion with no further paths.

scenes.title: Recovered Ally
scenes.background: The cave on the asteroid, where the rebel stands, now healed. The nebula glows, and the drones are gone. Music: A hopeful track with soft flutes and a gentle hum.
scenes.description: You tend to the rebel, using the cave’s resources to heal their injuries. They stand, grateful, as the nebula glows outside and the drones depart. The crystal pulses faintly, and the rebel suggests a plan to return to Eldoria. What do you do?

choices.outcome: You set course, leading to a final confrontation.
The crystal reveals a portal, leading to escape.
You exit with the rebel, seeking a new path.

scenes.title: Crystal Signal
scenes.background:
The cave on the asteroid, where the crystal emits a bright signal. Faerie ships or Grackle drones approach, their lights piercing the nebula. Music: A tense track with rising hums and distant engines.
Description
The crystal emits a signal, its light piercing the nebula. Faerie ships or Grackle drones approach, their lights growing brighter. The rebel, if with you, braces for conflict, and the cave offers little defense. What do you do?

choices.outcome: The faeries aid you, leading to a return.
You repel the drones but are captured later.
The threat passes, leading to survival.
